quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026: revenue RMB 1.05 billion, +90.39% year on year; net profit attributable RMB 379.49 million, +334.32%. The company attributes the growth to strong demand and higher prices for ordinary E-glass electronic fabric, and to strong demand for low-Dk and low-CTE specialty fabric with rising capacity, higher sales volumes and higher unit prices; the specialty fabric share of revenue rose.

quarterly_data.quarter: Grace Fabric Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supply: demand for both E-glass and specialty electronic fabric was strong in H1 2026 and capacity was tight; the company cut output of thick and thin E-glass fabric to make more specialty and ultra-thin / extra-thin high-end fabric, and in H1 2026 planned new specialty yarn and high-end fabric projects at subsidiary Huangshi Grace. Its low-Dk and low-CTE specialty fabrics passed downstream customer certification in 2024 and batch supply to CCL customers began in 2025. Specialty fabric capacity, selling prices and gross margin all rose.

quarterly_data.quarter: Grace Fabric Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management view: AI servers use more PCB layers, so glass-fabric consumption per unit is several times that of a traditional server; the move of switches from 400G to 800G and 1.6T makes low-dielectric glass fabric a core requirement; low-CTE fabric demand is growing fast because advanced IC package substrates face strict thermal-cycling reliability requirements. Subsidiary Huangshi Grace can produce 3-micron ultra-fine electronic glass yarn.

Grace Fabric Technology.why: Maker of ultra-thin and low-Dk / low-CTE specialty electronic glass fabric sold to CCL makers (Elite Material, ITEQ, TUC) for AI server, switch and IC-substrate laminates; AI build-outs drive its volumes and prices.
